displayServer: native renderer (OpenGL 4.1 Metal, Apple M3 Pro, Compatibility renderer)

exampleValidation.command: node scripts/check.mjs --typography --capture (the same run as npm run example -- typography --capture)
exampleValidation.note: the example's own validation saves the frames; the checks below read the pixels of the initial frame against what the host reported
pixelChecks: Pixels confirmam que o itálico sintético inclina a tinta para a direita
Pixels confirmam a linha de textDecorationColor na altura do sublinhado e em nenhuma outra
Pixels confirmam o tachado no meio da caixa do trecho
Pixels confirmam o sublinhado do pai e o buraco deixado pelo span que o cancela
headlessChecksOfTheLine: Itálico sintético inclina os glifos sem mudar avanço, largura nem quebras
Sublinhado, tachado e decoração colorida (NativeWind) desenham uma linha por trecho, na cor do texto ou na de textDecorationColor
Um span com textDecorationLine none cancela o sublinhado do pai e o texto seguinte volta a ser sublinhado

cropDriver.note: the driver is not project code: it crops the region (12, 398, 312, 114) of the initial frame and enlarges it by 4 with nearest-neighbour sampling

determinism: node scripts/check.mjs --typography --capture ran twice in a row on the pinned commit and saved the very same bytes for the initial, changed, narrow and clip frames; the crop is a pure function of the initial frame, and a second run of the driver saved the same bytes

initial.source: frame 'initial' of the typography example's own validation
initial.description: the laboratory at rest, 900 x 980, with the new rows under the regular and bold Hamburgefonts

zoom.description: the new rows enlarged by 4: upright and italic Hamburgefonts, the line of italic, underline, line-through and colored decoration, and the span that cancels its parent's underline

narrow.source: frame 'narrow' of the typography example's own validation
narrow.description: the window narrowed to 620 x 1100 after the fonts were changed to the monospaced family and a child was added: the new rows are unchanged
